thesis: Robinhood Chain speculative activity is now producing a measurable upstream revenue stream for the Arbitrum ecosystem under the Arbitrum Expansion Program, and ARB has begun repricing on that causal link with high liquid-market participation.

regime_evidence.interpretation: High turnover and fee production alongside negative net inflows continues to favor a capital-velocity/speculation interpretation rather than simple deposit growth.

arb_evidence.robinhood_aep_mechanism: 10% of Robinhood Chain net protocol revenue returns to the Arbitrum ecosystem; 8% to ArbitrumDAO treasury and 2% to the Developer Guild.

leadership_interpretation: This is a new upstream spillover leader rather than a replacement for PONS/CASHCAT/AI inside Robinhood Chain. It is a more liquid expression of the same regime and therefore should be tracked separately from microcap/native leadership rotation.
wallet_quality: No selective-wallet convergence was established in this run. For ARB, broad multi-exchange liquidity reduces microcap wallet-structure risk but does not substitute for wallet-flow confirmation.

notes: Established, widely traded governance token with deep multi-exchange liquidity.
No microcap-style LP/deployer/honeypot gate concerns surfaced.
Upcoming unlock on 2026-09-16 releases 92.65M ARB (0.93% of total supply), a material supply-overhang risk but not a structural failure.

major_uncertainties: ARB move also overlaps a broader DeFi/rollup rotation and leverage expansion, so not all price response can be attributed to Robinhood Chain.
Robinhood Chain activity may be temporarily amplified by subsidized gas and meme-launchpad activity.
The durability of AEP revenue after the current speculative regime cools remains unproven.
No selective-wallet convergence was verified for ARB.
preservation_note: Stored outside signals/ so this observation cannot trigger paper execution.
